rules: Public price capture is preferred when supplier pages expose pack and price data without authentication.
Never trust a displayed unit-price label when case arithmetic produces a different delivered unit cost.
Always preserve raw displayed values and derived normalized values separately.
Do not infer HT/TTC status. Store UNKNOWN when the page does not make it explicit.
Do not infer delivery inclusion. Store null when unknown.
Do not compute price_per_piece without a reliable unit_count.
Do not compute price_per_kg without a reliable net pack weight.
A captured supplier price is not SELECTED_EFFECTIVE_PRODUCT_COST.
Final Make_or_Buy cost adds internal avoidable handling, reheating, labor, packaging and expected losses.
Authenticated sources may be activated later without changing the observation schema.
